facts.text: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.
facts.why: No scene of Po cramming buns into his mouth turns up in the plot, quote page or Fandom page. Printed as the kitchen tip on face 1 and as the data cue.
facts.fix: Serve the buns when Mr. Ping tells Po he found him in a crate of radishes.

facts.text: Mr Ping swears there's no secret ingredient.
facts.why: The no secret ingredient gag belongs to the first film. The noodle shop page for KFP2 only says the soup has a secret ingredient known to Po and his family.
facts.fix: Mr Ping's secret ingredient, no peeking.

vibe.verdict: Mr. Ping's shop is the right place and the radish crate and Shen's fireworks are good picks, but a couple of jokes lean on the first film.
